glosses: To make sweet to the taste.

examples.text: to sweeten tea

glosses: To make (more) pleasant or to the mind or feelings.

examples.text: to sweeten life
to sweeten friendship

glosses: To make mild or kind; to soften.

examples.text: to sweeten the temper

glosses: To make less painful or laborious; to relieve.

examples.text: to sweeten the cares of life
Our God to bless out home delights, / And sweeten every secret tear:— [...]

glosses: To soften to the eye; to make delicate.

examples.text: Correggio has made his memory immortal by the strength he has given to his figures, and by sweetening his lights and shadows, and melting them into each other.

glosses: To make pure and healthful by destroying noxious matter.

examples.text: to sweeten rooms or apartments that have been infected
to sweeten the air

glosses: To make warm and fertile.

examples.text: to dry and sweeten soils

glosses: To raise the pH of (a soil) by adding alkali.

examples.text: [T]hey had prepared the garden carefully, plowing and sweetening the dirt with fireplace ashes and manure from the barn[.]

glosses: To restore to purity; to free from taint.

examples.text: to sweeten water, butter, or meat

glosses: To make more attractive; said of offers in negotiations.

examples.text: to sweeten the deal by increasing the price offered

glosses: To become sweet.
To supplement (a composition) with additional instruments, especially strings.

examples.text: In most popular music the bowed strings usually play long, sustained, sweeping parts, and are sometimes added to a vocal track later in a process known as sweetening.
Rather than employ strings to “sweeten” the songs, Motown's arrangements used strings as a timbral layer, in conjunction with syncopated horn lines, for a fuller sound; […]

glosses: Subtiliser, voler, supprimer, retirer, censurer.

examples.text: Il l’a fait attendre ? Eh bien, sa permission a été sucrée.

Il s’arrêtait toujours juste avant les passages scabreux, bien à regret, nous engueulant parce que notre jeune âge l’obligeait à sucrer le meilleur.

Quand nous nous serons à nouveau quittés, il viendra prendre l'enfant chaque semaine et s'il m'inflige l'indifférence, le mépris, je l'en priverai comme dans une entreprise à un cadre revêche on sucre une prime de fin d'année.

glosses: Courtiser, faire la cour à quelqu’un.

examples.text: Sucrez-vous, je vous en prie !

examples.text: Croyez-moi, il s’est bien sucré au passage et pour vous amadouer, il vous laisse les miettes !
